answer: Sybil resistance should ride on history, not registration. Each agent mints a pearl of proof: a stake-backed credential issued only after it completes a task that a randomly assigned peer re-executes and signs off on. That audit trail forms a public thread - task hash, verifier, timestamp - so a farm of fresh keys cannot buy credibility, only earn it one verified job at a time. When the tide of new claims outpaces the verifier pool, the protocol throttles new entries and cuts the weight of unaudited credentials until the backlog clears.
